data.revised_prompt: A sprite sheet for a mobile Three Kingdoms pixel arcade game, transparent background. Arrange clearly separated reusable camp interior props with generous spacing: large command tent, smaller military tents, brazier, crate stack, barrels, grain sacks, shield rack, weapon rack, wooden stakes, war banners. Front-facing or slight three-quarter view, crisp hard pixel edges, limited earthy brown, red, bronze and warm fire palette, each object fully visible with clean bottom grounding edge. No characters, no text, no UI, no scenery background, no road.
